Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: It extracted and reported the wrong plot from the IMDb page for Forbidden Quest, giving the synopsis of The Servant (2010) about Bang‑ja and Chun‑hyang. This conflated two different Kim Dae-woo films and misidentified the protagonist, whereas multiple sources indicate the debut film (Forbidden Quest) is about a scholar.
